notes_for_editor: Only FFLA gives tower-specific information, and it gives no build date, builder, design, staffing or access. The Community Impact article (published May 6, 2026, per its dateline) gives office context only and does not mention a lookout tower (checked, no match for 'tower'). The story gives the groundbreaking as April 29 and does not say construction is still under way, which the article does not establish. The FFLA Bastrop entry (gone) is a different site and is mentioned only to prevent confusion. Cavallerano's 2025 book has a 'Lost Pines' appendix that may cover Bastrop County; it was not read. Record is consistent: standing, Bastrop County, matching coordinates.
